item.title: 'Trump announced a ceasefire – and there are sirens': northern Israelis push back from the war-torn border
item.description:
The Israel-Hezbollah ceasefire finalized Wednesday is drawing sharp criticism from residents along the northern border, where sirens still wail daily despite Trump's de-escalation announcement. A new Agam Labs survey at Hebrew University, shared with Reuters, shows Likud support in the north collapsing as voters reject Netanyahu's handling of the Lebanon war and Washington's push for a truce.
